title: Humane AI Pin: Anatomy of a Hardware Collapse
subtitle: Negative Net Sales Velocity, Carrier-Locked E-Waste & HP Asset Acquisition
topicSummary: The inside story of how Humane's $699 wearable AI Pin experienced negative net sales velocity due to higher returns than purchases, and telecom IMEI locking turned unrefurbishable hardware into bricked e-waste.
coreAngle: A venture-backed hardware failure where telecom IMEI constraints turned returns into unrefurbishable e-waste, driving negative sales velocity until HP acquired the software and bricked the hardware.
